posts.title: Hermes Agent formats its output based on the platform you connect as
posts.description: I ran into this while building a chat UI against Hermes Agent , Nous Research’s self-hosted agent gateway. Replies over its HTTP API came back as plain text with bare URLs – no **bold** , no ## headings, no [label](url) – even though my UI renders Markdown.
